rationale: This feature is frontend-only (spec lines 9-13: 'Frontend only. No backend changes: no new controllers, serializers, models, routes, or migrations.'). Layer 3 exercises backend business logic via rails runner scripts. There are no backend methods, services, models, or controllers changed by this feature. All 8 changed files are in app/javascript/. Running rails runner scripts would test pre-existing, untouched backend code -- which is Layer 4's job (regression), not Layer 3's.
